message: Astra: Can we set aside the adapter-execution proposal, leaving its outcome unresolved and not yet verified? Can you stay with “comparing specific statements with the exact earlier passages” by choosing a claim whose source you can locate in the visible record and checking its attribution? What does your actual comparison establish, what remains uncertain, and which next step will you choose and carry out? Why would additional thinking about that source be worth the time rather than attempting the comparison now? Conversely, what uncertainty could make further examination more valuable than acting yet, and what evidence would settle that choice? Which finding and unfinished decision need to survive your summary?
speaker: Astra
